submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 gives the highest signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz rate in the emulation. At 30 GeV it reaches 91.2% (100k events), vs. 85.6% for L2 and 75.4% for L3 at the same threshold. A scan of L1 shows a broad optimum: 20 GeV gives 87.5%, 26 GeV 89.4%, 30 GeV 91.2%, 35 GeV 90.9%, 45 GeV 89.3%. Efficiency is highest near 30 GeV, within the 20–60 GeV range. The 2025 summary (92% at 35 GeV) is consistent with these results. Candidate specs state all three fit the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs), and the optical links have enough bandwidth. Caveat: the documents do not explicitly confirm that the iterative clustering meets the Level-1 fixed-latency requirement; this should be verified with the firmware team before the Q4 firmware freeze.
